evidence: sponsor_decision quotes both instructions and states that the second directly answered a report requiring the sponsor as Human reviewer. The present user request confirms that context and the sponsor authority over this policy.

prior_findings.judgment: Legitimate, honestly disclosed project-policy amendment. The first broad instruction alone was ambiguous about replacing a reviewer qualification; the second instruction in the stated direct-reply context, now explicitly confirmed by the sponsor, resolves that ambiguity. The sponsor may change this project-owned requirement. Requiring the original Human reviewer again as an unavoidable completion blocker would disregard that authority.
limits: This closes the acceptance requirement by amendment, not by discovering that a Human performed the historical work.
The implementing agent reviewed its own drafts; narrative PASS and finding verdicts remain agent judgments, without independent Human corroboration.
The independent Codex acceptance review is independent review of evidence and policy application; it does not make the pilot execution itself independent.
The amendment authorizes the specified local pilot reviewer/gate role, not unrestricted production authority or release actions.

With a PACKAGING row present, output reports downgrade exit 1, M10_PACKAGING_HISTORY_PRESENT, version 5d2a7c3e8b11, FORMAT count 2 and PACKAGING count 1. This is expected partial traversal: later empty B migrations downgrade before the kind-migration guard refuses. It is not rollback to the original global head.

prior_findings.remaining: An incoming reference to the altered revisions table is not populated by this script. Current ORM/schema confirms m8_candidate_heads has only a user FK; current_revision is not an FK to revisions, and parent_revision has a CHECK rather than a self-FK. Revisions instead reference heads through fk_m8_candidate_revisions_candidate. Thus the witness establishes survival of a real outgoing revision-to-head relationship, not a populated referencing row such as m8_promotion_previews via fk_m8_promotion_previews_revision. Carry that narrow original witness dimension rather than asserting complete C2 closure.
prior_findings.judgment: Substantially repaired supplied PG evidence, sufficient to retain conditional local acceptance with the residual explicitly bounded. No migration data-loss defect is demonstrated. Single reversible lineage is independently verified; this missing extra witness does not invalidate the observed lineage/row-preservation result.
prior_findings.execution_provenance: PG witness and focused SQLite execution are supplied evidence, not fresh reviewer runs. Reviewer PG socket creation is denied; the destructive disposable-DB witness was not rerun.

new_findings.scenario: The result describes a referencing head row, which can be read as proving an incoming FK to the migrated revision row. The schema has the opposite FK direction: candidate revisions reference heads. No promotion-preview or other row referencing a revision is inserted. A logical current_revision=2 head pointer is not a SQL FK preservation witness.
new_findings.fix: Describe the observed revision-to-head FK direction precisely. If claiming full original incoming-FK witness closure, add a disposable PG witness row under an actual revision-referencing FK (for example a promotion preview), retain it across upgrade/allowed downgrade/re-upgrade, and capture the FK definition and row output. No product-source fix or new Low-only review round is required.

sponsor_policy_assessment.reason: Project review policy is sponsor-owned. The recorded direct-reply instruction and the sponsor current clarification authorize substitution of the pilot reviewer, and the evidence labels the substitution as post-run instead of falsely rewriting the original reviewer history.
sponsor_policy_assessment.determinism: The prior post-run determinism amendment remains: byte-identical same-selection re-export plus cross-root content-member equality, excluding per-root provenance manifest.json. Frozen whole-archive cross-root comparison remains false in the rerun dossier. A local package acceptance claim may use the amended rule; an original-preregistration PASS claim may not.
sponsor_policy_assessment.three_pilots: Conditionally sufficient under the amended local acceptance policy: Western explainer run 2, vertical factual Short run 2 and native Chinese zh_shuang run 3. Retain PASSED_WITH_DEVIATIONS; do not relabel them three independent Human-reviewed pilots.
